one_line_contribution: A 2x2 'provenance square' in ALFWorld that crosses the episode-provenance of a GEPA-optimized instruction against the task-type relevance of a distilled procedural memory bank, and reports the resulting 'absorbed share' A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) as a scale-free ratio with a confidence interval and a null replicate — i.e., putting a number and an identification strategy on a substitution claim the literature has so far only asserted qualitatively.
closest_prior_work: EvoAgentBench (cited as arXiv 2607.05202) is the real threat: it already puts ReasoningBank (+3.6) and GEPA (+1.2) on the *same* 528/267 training trajectories, which is the qualitative headline ('an optimizer given the same episodes gets roughly what the bank gets'). The proposal concedes this in its first paragraph, and correctly notes EvoAgentBench has no provenance manipulation, no combined optimizer+memory cell, no token matching and no paired statistics — so the interaction is genuinely unidentified there. What the proposal never answers is the reviewer's follow-up: which practical decision flips between 'roughly equal gains on a shared pool' and 'A = 0.6 with a 90% LB of 0.25'? If the answer is 'none', the increment is a measurement refinement. Two secondary threats: ExpeL (2308.10144), whose distilled insights block *is* a prepended instruction, meaning the two 'containers' are not architecturally distinct in the closest target system; and Experience Distillation (2607.21051), which already establishes the retention-ratio measurement object (>=64.8% of the in-context gain retained) with weights as the second container — the proposal admits this is where its ratio endpoint came from. MIPROv2 (2406.11695) is a weaker threat since it neither retrieves nor manipulates provenance. I cannot independently verify the 2026-dated IDs.
strongest_objection: The confirmatory reading is unpowered exactly where it tests the title. The proposal says 'the confirmatory reading is taken at the conservative end' and names Ladder T (A_epi) as that end, but the operational bar it then states is A - A_h >= 0.30, where A_h = 0.06-0.12 is the *least* aggressive of the two candidate corrections. The two are not the same requirement, and the text never resolves which one gates publication. If it is A_epi (prediction 4: A_epi >= 0.2), the claim rests on the least-precise number in the study: row 4 is n=500 with ONE optimizer seed, and Inner-hat' is *interpolated* between two ladder levels. Using the proposal's own arithmetic, instance SE = sqrt(0.20/500) = 2.0pt, plus 0.8pt optimizer = ~2.2pt per level against a 6-8pt quantity; propagating that through the ratio gives SE(A_epi) ~ 0.3, so a 90% LB >= 0.2 needs A_epi-hat near 0.6. The MDE table covers only A and stops precisely where A_epi and A_type begin — the one quantity that separates 'these episodes' from 'this task type' has no stated MDE. If instead the bar is only A - A_h >= 0.30, the bracket is decorative and the sole correction applied is the multiplicative-headroom model, which is wrong in the direction that inflates A: I_own solves the type-specific-easy games first, so its residual unsolved set is depleted of exactly the games B_own can fix. That is selection on the residual set, not uniform compression, and A_h does not bound it. Compounding this: the denominator's reference instruction I_oth is not neutral — G3b actively *requires* it to be 3pt worse on own-type games, i.e. the design gates on the mis-specialization that inflates Inner(I_oth); an instruction optimized to 'go to the microwave' will fail T_A games in ways the on-type bank repairs, driving A toward 1 with zero content transfer. And by the proposal's own risk 8, the treatment-free null floor of A is expected at 0.12-0.21 against a 0.2 decision threshold — the endpoint's noise floor overlaps its own decision rule, which is the track brief's stated out-of-scope condition applied to the primary. The honest forecast is an inconclusive primary plus a fallback paper.
what_would_fix_it: (1) State ONE operational confirmatory bar and power it. If Ladder T is the conservative end, run its two bracketing levels at row-2 scale (n=1,200, two optimizer seeds) and publish MDE rows for A_epi and A_type next to the existing table for A; pay for it out of rows 13 (coupling), 15 (step control) and one seed of row 12. (2) Stop using a deliberately mis-specialized instruction as the denominator's reference. Promote I_all x {B_own, B_oth} to Tier 0 so Inner is also read at an instruction that saw both type sets' episodes, and report A0 = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I0*) alongside A; if A and A0 disagree, the gap is the negative-transfer artifact. (3) Add the bank-side mirror of I': B'_own distilled from P'_train (same three types, disjoint episodes). Episode-vs-type granularity is currently testable only on the instruction side. (4) Promote M_shuf (within-domain, token-matched, retrieval bypassed) to Tier 0. X_dist is reformatted multi-hop-QA text — out-of-domain and trivially ignorable — while B_oth is topically plausible ALFWorld procedure; the track's own prior finding is that the harmful bank retrieved topically *correct* items, so X_dist does not control the distractor-robustness rival that Rule M routes to. (5) Use the frontier reflector the track brief explicitly grants ('a few hundred dollars total') for at least the I_own/I_oth arms. The proposal's 'no API key on this node' contradicts its own resource envelope, self-imposes a weak I_own, and turns G2 into a live coin flip for no scientific gain. (6) Enforce 'same episodes' by episode-set identity rather than by capping GEPA at 350 rollouts; as written the treatment instruction gets one sweep while the Ladder T control gets 500-750, and the fairness constraint is the reason G2 may fail.
missing_baseline: The episode-disjoint BANK, B'_own — the same three task types distilled from P'_train, the pool that produced I'. The design manipulates episode provenance only on the instruction side, so the central sentence ('the same training episodes in two containers') is tested asymmetrically: if B'_own yields the same Inner as B_own, the bank carries only type-level content and the episode framing is dead on the container the paper is about, regardless of what A_epi says. It costs one distillation and one grid cell. Runner-up omissions a reviewer would also demand at Tier 0: Inner measured at the practitioner instruction (I_all x {B_own, B_oth}), and M_shuf as the within-domain distractor control.
preprint_collision: The check is well above the norm for a proposal — a dated fresh scan (2026-09-03), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, 54 by-id abstract verifications, one competitor PDF read in full with a committed SHA256, a self-correction of a misreported +7 to +3.6, and a reinstatement of five citations wrongly retracted in an earlier version. It also concedes the two collisions that actually matter (EvoAgentBench's shared-trajectory table; ExpeL's memory-as-instruction) in the first paragraph of Related Work rather than burying them. I credit that. But it has three defects that bear directly on the novelty score. (a) The search that most threatens the claimed contribution has never been run: the proposal admits the provenance/held-out-data crossover primitive in the contamination and data-attribution literatures is unsearched from this node, marks it 'freeze-blocking', and makes its novelty claim explicitly conditional on it. An unrun search on the exact primitive the identification rests on is a weakness, not a neutral, and the proposal pre-concedes that a hit reduces the contribution to 'the ALFWorld measurement'. (b) arXiv is unreachable from the node, so every 2026 ID except EvoAgentBench rests on a single web-snippet channel, and every 'confirmed absent from the paper' claim about a competitor is asserted from an abstract — including the absences that carry the novelty argument. (c) The appendix of arXiv 2608.14036 is unopened and is named by the authors as the collision that would gut prediction 6 (compile-once). I am aware of no preprint through my own knowledge that runs this specific provenance square, and the nearest published claims are the ones the authors named; but the proposal's own verdict — 'the contribution is the identification and the number, not the idea' — is the collision finding a reviewer would write, and it caps novelty rather than establishing it.
